subject.title: refactor(auth): harden CLI forwarding proposal boundary

question: Should the existing bundled CLI auth bridge be replaced now by a generic, minimized provider-owned forwarding contract?
rationale: Fixing the mutation bug is mechanical, but choosing the permanent secret-materialization owner and plugin contract requires explicit auth/security maintainer intent.

options.title: Sponsor full migration
options.body: Fix the immutable identity boundary and replace the current bridge and concrete consumer together with compatibility tests and live proof.

options.title: Retain current bridge
options.body: Keep the reviewed bundled-only boundary and close this standalone generic proposal until another concrete consumer establishes the need.

recommendation.title: Sponsor full migration
recommendation.body: Fix the immutable identity boundary and replace the current bridge and concrete consumer together with compatibility tests and live proof.
